# NextDine — The Complete Digital Dining OS Built For Modern Outlets

> NextDine is an Indian SaaS platform providing contactless table QR code ordering, real-time Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), high-resolution digital visual menus, and restaurant billing telemetry for cafes, fine-dining restaurants, bars, and cloud kitchens.

## Overview

- **Website**: https://nextdine.in
- **Legal Entity**: NextDine Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- **Headquarters**: Level 4, Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400051, India
- **Support**: support@nextdine.in | +91 98765 43210
- **Primary Value Proposition**: Eliminates waiter transcription mistakes, accelerates table turnaround, and removes 3rd-party food aggregator commission cuts (18%–26%) through direct table-to-kitchen ordering.

## Core Features

1. **Table QR Code Ordering**:
   - Guests point native smartphone camera at durable table standees.
   - 100% web-native: Zero app installation (iOS App Store or Google Play) required.
   - Retains table session context and supports simultaneous group ordering.

2. **Real-Time Kitchen Display System (KDS)**:
   - Orders stream to kitchen screens within 0.2 seconds via WebSockets.
   - Built-in Web Audio chime notifications and color-coded overdue warnings.
   - Compatible with any tablet (iPad, Android), touch monitor, or commercial smart TV.

3. **Gourmet Visual Menu & 1-Tap 86'd Sync**:
   - High-resolution dish photography with category filters and dish modifiers.
   - Out-of-stock items can be disabled instantly with one tap from the manager's phone.

4. **Hardware & Thermal Printing**:
   - Direct support for ESC/POS standard USB, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth receipt printers (58mm and 80mm formats).

5. **Owner Telemetry & Revenue Analytics**:
   - Live gross sales, GST calculation, item velocity breakdown, and staff preparation speed tracking.

## Pricing & Subscription Model

- **Subscription Fee**: ₹999 / month (Flat rate, billed monthly).
- **Commission Rate**: 0% (Restaurants keep 100% of guest order revenue).
- **Onboarding Fee**: ₹2,999 (One-time, covers custom QR acrylic standees & menu digitalization).
- **Volume Limits**: Unlimited tables, unlimited outlets, and unlimited orders per month.
- **Free Trial**: 14-day fully featured free trial with zero credit card required.
